name: His Fragile Mind
storyline:
Niel's life is a constant pursuit of trying to restore meaning to his life.
His daily life is a failed attempt to combine work, taking medication and socializing with old friends.

The only thing he cares about is returning to his mental state from years ago. The only way to achieve this is to play the role of a superhero saving others.

Defeat the monsters lurking in the heads of your friends. Make them achieve a happy ending and perhaps.... also benefit from it yourself?
summary:
Niel's life is a constant pursuit of trying to restore meaning to his life.
His daily life is a failed attempt to combine work, taking medication and socializing with old friends.

The only thing he cares about is returning to his mental state from years ago. The only way to achieve this is to play the role of a superhero saving others.

Defeat the monsters lurking in the heads of your friends. Make them achieve a happy ending and perhaps.... also benefit from it yourself?

The gameplay consists of spending time with Niel's friends, visiting bars, and working as a superhero. You will play many various mini-games and fight with frightening enemies, just to make your friends happy.

His Fragile Mind has 4 endings - your fights are going to make a real difference.
